title: PADI Open Water course
text: After a spending our weekend with Alex from iDive Bcn, we successfully completed our PADI Open Water course. From the moment we had our first contact to saying goodbye at the dive site, our experience with this company was excellent! The communication was all in English and very fast, and they were accommodating to schedule changes too. Alex made sure we felt completely comfortable both in and out the water. title: Phenomenal Experience
text: 10/10 would recommend! I came to Spain for a work trip & wanted to do something for myself while here. I signed up for the 1 day course via Viator which will certify you to scuba, but only with a PADI certified instructor. Sid let me know this my first day & let me sign up for the 2nd day which certified me to scuba on my own (with a buddy of course). From start to finish, Sid was great. I struggled a bit on day 1, almost quit & he was able to help me work through it & I am SO glad he did. Highlight of my trip!
author: Brianna_C
